attribution.note: Marcus offers his own retrospective assessment of his earlier prediction.

semantics.note: The normalisation preserves his qualified assessment, partial-correctness language, and express concession about timing.

contract.note: The contract fairly identifies undefined standards for attack size and partial correctness. Choosing those standards would determine the result without sufficient guidance from his words.

evidence.note: Available by the cutoff, the technical report establishes relevant incident details. It establishes neither historical rank nor whether the earlier prediction was largely vindicated.

reviews.rationale: This qualified retrospective assessment supplies neither a measure of largest nor a reproducible standard for partial correctness. The incident report cannot resolve those ambiguities. The inaccessible earlier article limits context but does not make the supplied statement or evidence item broken.
